summary.text: Curtis Goodwin is the Libertarian nominee for Arizona's 2nd Congressional District, facing Rep. Eli Crane and Democrat Jonathan Nez. He says he was born and raised in Mesa, Arizona, and has worked as a technician.

paragraphs.text: Goodwin completed his high school studies as a homeschooled student, according to Ballotpedia, and has worked as a technician.
He says he has a daughter, a grandson and a son, and that he has traveled to 268 different cities across the United States in the last eight years.
